# WEIGHT

Weight the cases by a variable, or turn weighting off.

## Syntax

```text
WEIGHT BY var.
WEIGHT OFF.
```

## Example

```text
WEIGHT BY weight.
```

`statscraft help WEIGHT` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
